steps.title: Desk page loads with Hypothesis Foundry panel
steps.narration: The Desk page is the operations center for research data. The Hypothesis Foundry panel contains research subsections ready to explore.
steps.point_out: The Hypothesis Foundry section is visible and ready to expand.

steps.title: Hypothesis Foundry panel expands with five subsections
steps.narration: The panel header shows the Source registry hash—now displaying a real, committed epoch identifier instead of a placeholder value.
steps.point_out: The Source registry hash field is populated with a real committed value, and five subsection headers are ready to explore.

steps.title: Sources/Compiler shows complete fixture metadata
steps.narration: The Sources subsection now displays three new fields on every fixture record. Both variants of the alias-family example appear as separate entries, each with full metadata.
steps.point_out: Each fixture shows Operative formula refs, Superseded fields, and Aliases/lineage ids. Notice both fixture-variant-a and fixture-variant-b are now visible as distinct rows.

steps.title: Hermetic Oracles displays kill-type mapping and sampling metrics
steps.narration: Hermetic Oracles now shows how outcome labels map to their internal foundry states. A Best-of-N disclosure line reports sampling details.
steps.point_out: The kill-type mapping pairs each outcome (fragile, survive, insufficient, etc.) with its real diagnostic state. The best-of-N line shows n_variants_tried and the decision threshold_bps.

steps.title: Epoch/Manifest subsection shows the real committed epoch
steps.narration: This new subsection is the iteration's main achievement: the era's first real, Git-frozen research epoch with an emerald banner marking it as production data.
steps.point_out: The 'Real Epoch — not a fixture' banner uses emerald/green color, visually distinct from the amber banners on fixture sections. The status confirms 'Committed — Git-visible pre-outcome barrier crossed.'

steps.title: Interpreter Fixtures subsection still renders correctly
steps.narration: Prior-iteration subsections remain stable. Interpreter Fixtures shows the expected hermetic fixture banner and scenario rows—confirming earlier work still passes.
steps.point_out: The amber 'Hermetic Fixture — not the real epoch' banner and the fixture scenario rows are intact, showing no regression in earlier iterations.

expect.text: Hermetic Fixture — not the real epoch

steps.title: Cockpit page loads normally
steps.narration: The Foundry changes are isolated to /desk. The Cockpit page loads with all controls and charts responsive, confirming no cross-page regressions.
steps.point_out: The navigation, ticker watch form, and example content all render correctly. The Hypothesis Foundry work didn't affect the main trading interface.

steps.title: Structure page loads normally
steps.narration: The Structure analysis page also works without issue, showing all panels are responsive. This confirms the iteration introduced no regressions.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map, Case Studies, and Edge Report sections all load as expected, with no errors or broken functionality.
